info.name: Campus Shoes - Notifications
info.description: In-app notification system: (1) /notifications/* — any authenticated user reads their own notification log, marks read, manages per-event/per-channel preferences, and registers a device for push (JwtAuthGuard + UserStatusGuard, no role restriction); (2) /super-admin/notification-templates/* — SUPERADMIN-only CRUD over the message templates each event type renders (create/update/soft-delete, audit-logged). Six built-in event types: INVOICE_CREATED, INVOICE_SUBMITTED, POINTS_ALLOCATED, ORDER_PLACED, REWARD_REDEEMED, PRODUCT_RETURNED. Two channels: IN_APP (always written synchronously) and PUSH (queued via BullMQ, real firebase-admin code but returns SKIPPED — not FAILED — until FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID/FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL/FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY are set).

item.name: Notifications
item.description: The caller's own notification log and preferences. Guarded by JwtAuthGuard + UserStatusGuard — works for any active user regardless of role.

request.description: Newest first. Response: { items: [{id, eventType, title, body, referenceType, referenceId, isRead, readAt, metadata, createdAt}], pagination }.
Set {{notificationId}} from 'List notifications'. Errors: NTF_001 not found (or not owned by this user), NTF_004 already read.
Marks every unread notification for this user as read.

Always returns all 6 event types x 2 channels (12 rows), merging any saved overrides with the opt-out default (enabled=true when no row exists yet). Response: { preferences: [{eventType, channel, enabled}] }.
Upserts one (eventType, channel) preference row. eventType: INVOICE_CREATED | INVOICE_SUBMITTED | POINTS_ALLOCATED | ORDER_PLACED | REWARD_REDEEMED | PRODUCT_RETURNED. channel: IN_APP | PUSH.

Upserts by device_token (unique) — re-registering the same token from a different user re-assigns it. platform: ANDROID | IOS | WEB. Used by FirebasePushProvider to know which devices to target for PUSH.
e.g. on logout — stops PUSH targeting this device.

item.name: Super Admin - Notification Templates
item.description: SUPERADMIN-only. GET/POST-only convention (no PATCH/DELETE) — update is POST /:id, delete is POST /delete/:id (soft — sets active=false; the notify() pipeline then treats that event type as having no template and skips it). Every create/update/delete is audit-logged via AuditService under entity type NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE.

request.description: All 6 built-in templates are seeded by migration. Response: { items: [{id, eventType, title, body, active}], pagination }.
Returns even soft-deleted (active=false) templates — deletion only hides them from the notify() pipeline, not from admin view. NTF_005 if the id doesn't exist at all.

title/body support {{placeholder}} substitution, rendered per-notify() call and snapshotted onto the resulting notifications row. NTF_006 if an (active) template for this eventType already exists — all 6 event types are pre-seeded, so this will normally only succeed after soft-deleting the existing one first.
eventType is not editable (it's the unique key templates are looked up by) — only title/body, both optional (send just the one you're changing).
Sets active=false. No restore endpoint yet — re-activate directly in DB, or POST a new template for the same eventType (the uniqueness check only looks at active rows).
